===========
General Process

1. Check Required Skill / Sophia Rank of Each Title
2. Do the Unlock Quest if the certain Title requires.
3. Open Your "Book of Wisdom" and check if the title was added to your toon.
4. Equip each title to your toon
5. Grind Expertise +5 a day until you reach max rank
6. UWC Item
1) Technology Revolutionist's Ice Confectionery (Remove Day limit)
2) Technology Revolutionist's Knowledge Book (Earn Expertise +1)
